fixture_purpose: Demonstrates that admission enforces QUEUE_DEPTH_MAX=64 and CONCURRENCY_MAX=16 caps in an atomic transaction, returning -32051 when exceeded. The sustained-5-minute hold trigger (metrics-based) requires a running system and is deferred to Phase 2 operator evidence.

evidence.mechanism: Saturation is computed inside a BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction. queue_depth (all non-terminal rows) and concurrency (active-execution states) are counted before insert. If queue_depth >= QUEUE_DEPTH_MAX (64) or concurrency >= CONCURRENCY_MAX (16), the transaction rolls back and returns AtomicAdmissionOutcome::Saturated with the observed counts.
evidence.deferred_evidence: Sustained-5-minute saturation hold verification requires real metric time-series from a running system. That evidence is deferred to Phase 2 operator readback.
